# splunkctl indexes

Manage Splunk indexes.

## indexes clean

Remove all events from an index.

> Guarded mutation — dry-run by default; apply with `--yes`.

```text
splunkctl indexes clean [OPTIONS] NAME
```

**Flags**

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--clean-timeout` | integer | 60 | Seconds to wait for the index to empty (default 60). |

## indexes create

Create a new index.

> Guarded mutation — dry-run by default; apply with `--yes`.

```text
splunkctl indexes create [OPTIONS]
```

**Flags**

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--name` | text | - | Index name. [required] |
| `--datatype` | choice: event, metric | - | Index datatype. |
| `--max-size` | integer | - | Max data size in MB. |
| `--frozen-period` | integer | - | Frozen time period in seconds. |
| `--home-path` | text | - | Home path for hot/warm buckets. |
| `--cold-path` | text | - | Cold path for cold buckets. |

## indexes delete

Delete an index.

> Guarded mutation — dry-run by default; apply with `--yes`.

```text
splunkctl indexes delete [OPTIONS] NAME
```

## indexes get

Get full index details.

```text
splunkctl indexes get [OPTIONS] NAME
```

## indexes list

List all indexes.

```text
splunkctl indexes list [OPTIONS]
```

**Flags**

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--limit` | integer range | - | Return at most N entries (default: all). |
| `--offset` | integer range | 0 | Skip the first N entries. |
| `--filter` | text | - | Case-insensitive name substring; --limit/--offset then apply to the filtered set. |

## indexes reload

Reload all index configurations.

> Guarded mutation — dry-run by default; apply with `--yes`.

```text
splunkctl indexes reload [OPTIONS]
```

## indexes update

Update index settings.

> Guarded mutation — dry-run by default; apply with `--yes`.

```text
splunkctl indexes update [OPTIONS] NAME
```

**Flags**

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--max-size` | integer | - | Max data size in MB. |
| `--frozen-period` | integer | - | Frozen time period in seconds. |
